title: Building a house: outside works, water and stairs
status: For building a house (E5): the compound wall, gate and paving round the plot; the sump, overhead tank, septic tank or sewer connection and rainwater harvesting; the stairs' finish. Quantities by the house rules in engine/data/architect.json (plot, outside, water, stair, cabin).

entries.name: Brick compound wall, 230 mm, plastered
entries.spec: A 230 mm (9-inch) brick wall about 1.5 m (5 ft) high on a footing with a plinth beam, plastered both sides
entries.note: HouseYog reports Rs. 800–1,100 a running foot for a 115 mm (4.5-inch) wall.

entries.name: MS gate, fabricated
entries.spec: A mild steel gate of two leaves, fabricated, primed and painted, fixed to its posts

entries.name: MS main gate, designed
entries.spec: A mild steel main gate with a designed panel (laser-cut or framed sheet), painted

entries.name: SS 304 sliding gate
entries.spec: A stainless steel (SS 304) sliding gate on a track

entries.name: SS 304 sliding gate with a motor
entries.spec: A stainless steel (SS 304) sliding gate with a motor and remote

entries.name: Automatic sliding gate, designer
entries.spec: An automatic motorised sliding gate, made to a design

entries.name: Concrete paver blocks, 60 mm
entries.spec: Interlocking concrete paver blocks 60 mm thick, laid on sand and compacted
entries.note: JK Cement recommends 80–100 mm blocks where a car stands.

entries.name: Exposed aggregate concrete
entries.spec: Concrete cast with decorative aggregate and washed to show the stones: seamless and anti-skid

entries.name: Sandstone pavers
entries.spec: Natural sandstone pavers laid in mortar

entries.name: Granite pavers, flamed
entries.spec: Flamed granite pavers laid in mortar
entries.note: Bespoke takes the same granite until a dearer stone is found.

entries.name: RCC sump
entries.spec: An underground RCC water tank: excavation, concrete, plaster and waterproofing, with a manhole cover
entries.note: Reported for a 5,000-litre tank; a 1,000-litre tank costs Rs. 28–35 a litre, and Studio Matrx reports Rs. 8–20 a litre for larger sumps.

entries.name: Overhead tank, three-layer plastic
entries.spec: A three-layer plastic water tank on the stair cabin's roof
entries.note: HouseYog reports plastic tanks of 1,000–5,000 litres at Rs. 7–12 a litre; its stand, float valve and pipes are with the plumbing.

entries.name: RCC septic tank with a soak pit
entries.spec: An RCC septic tank with its inlet, outlet and vent pipes and covers, and a soak pit

entries.name: Sewer connection
entries.spec: The house's drain to the road's manhole, and the city's charges for joining it
entries.note: The charges differ by city: Hyderabad's supervision charge is Rs. 1,500–5,000; Kolkata charges Rs. 2,079 a metre of pipe laid. No rate yet.

entries.name: Rainwater recharge pit with a filter
entries.spec: The roof's downpipes led through a mesh filter to a recharge pit

entries.name: Recharge pit, 4–5 ft
entries.spec: A recharge pit 4–5 ft deep with its filter media

entries.name: Mesh filter
entries.spec: A basic mesh filter for the roof's water

entries.name: Pipes and fittings
entries.spec: Downpipes and fittings from the roof to the pit

entries.name: Labour
entries.spec: Labour to lay the pipes and build the pit, a small home

entries.name: Kota stone steps
entries.spec: Kota stone on the treads, risers and landings, laid and polished

entries.name: Granite steps
entries.spec: Polished granite treads and risers, and granite on the landings, laid in mortar

entries.name: Indian marble steps
entries.spec: Indian white marble on the treads, risers and landings, laid and polished

entries.name: Italian marble steps (Botticino)
entries.spec: Italian Botticino marble on the treads, risers and landings, laid and polished

entries.name: Italian marble steps (Statuario)
entries.spec: Italian Statuario marble on the treads, risers and landings, laid and polished
